title: 可解释性语言模型的规模化
summary: 本文挑战了可解释性会牺牲能力的观点，将可解释性作为训练约束，与语言建模目标共同优化。在三个数量级的计算规模下，可解释性随能力提升而增强。作者提出Steerling-8B扩散语言模型，支持输出归因和概念干预，且性能可与计算量高2-16倍的模型竞争。
summary_en: This work challenges the view that interpretability comes at a cost to capability, making it a training constraint. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, interpretability scales with capability. Steerling-8B, a diffusion LM, enables output attribution and concept steering, remaining competitive with models trained on 2-16x more compute.
